title: Walls and Gates
keyIdea: Multi-source BFS from all gates at once. BFS reaches rooms in order of distance, so the first time an empty room (INF) is reached, rooms[r][c] + 1 is its distance to the nearest gate; filled rooms are never touched again.

approaches.name: DFS from each gate (with revisiting)
approaches.idea: DFS from every gate carrying the distance; overwrite a room only if this path is shorter.
approaches.why: Rooms can be re-explored every time a shorter distance arrives.

approaches.name: Multi-source BFS from all gates
approaches.idea: Queue every gate; pop a room, fill each INF neighbour with distance + 1 and queue it.
approaches.why: Each room is filled and queued once.

quiz.q: Why start BFS from all gates at the same time?
options: Then every room is reached first from its nearest gate, in one BFS
It must start from one gate

quiz.q: Why skip rooms that are not INF?
options: They already have their smallest distance (or are walls/gates)

quiz.q: Why is plain DFS (fill once, never revisit) wrong here?
options: It can reach a room along a long path first and keep that larger distance
